question: Does source-matched ROOK serialization plus a smaller fixed learning rate avoid the v1 format failure on entirely new games?

acquisition.selection: bounded prefix convenience sample, first eligible unique games in each hash bucket

exclusions: Every historical seed game/board and EVERY v1 train/development/holdout game and board; new unique games/boards across splits

training.target: native P:/M:/E:/B: serialization with five paired candidates and completion-only joint tokenization
training.precision: float32 parameters with CUDA bfloat16 autocast if supported

generation.input: P: + current FEN padded to90 + literal M: marker; no candidate, score, answer or continuation
generation.action_parser: B: first legal-shape UCI token; if absent use first M: candidate, flag fallback separately

evaluation.development: same128 new development positions before/after fixed training
evaluation.holdout: one final before/after comparison on128 new games; no tuning
evaluation.claim_boundary: descriptive pilot; no Elo, statistical significance, professional commentary, novel-game generalization, or sports-transfer claim

video_policy: GothamChess media are private observational challenge sources, never training data. Only verified game positions can enter a separately frozen video challenge set.
teacher_rationales: No invented natural-language Stockfish rationale. Proprietary frontier model outputs and Chess.com analyses are not used as training targets.
success_criterion: Pipeline completion requires retained source/engine/model hashes, real optimizer updates and full before/after denominators. Quality improvement is an observed outcome, not required or presumed. Any later larger experiment requires a new protocol.
ai_assistance: Implementation and candidate notes prepared with Codex assistance; Lucas reviews research interpretation and any supervisor-facing writing.
source_reuse: Verified exact v1 captured4MiB prefix bytes, new selections only; no invented fresh acquisition

upstream_serialization.note: Preserve P prefix and M/E padding; use Stockfish side-to-move best candidate0 rather than copying upstream black-selection code.

v1_status: Failed experiment retained; neither its holdout nor trained weights used forv2 selection. Multiplev2 changes mean this is not a causal single-factor ablation.
